name: Astrafex Core (regions, pixel table, calibration, forced photometry, scripts)
description: Stand-alone shell of the compute core that the Astrafex Web server also uses (one core, two shells): DS9/JSON/CSV regions with exact pixel statistics and masks, pixel table, weight/rms/exposure/mask map association, header-driven AB zero points, multi-band forced photometry (detection image, forced aperture/Kron/isophotal, correlated-noise errors, upper limits, colours; optional PSF matching) and a runner for astrafex-script/1 step lists, replay scripts and bundles exported from the web app. Runs headless; the core lives in the Astrafex Web repository and is started as a separate process. Includes the shared-core LSBG finder (ds10core.tools.lsbg); sky catalogue query / cross-match, MAST search and download, and user Python plugins; star aperture photometry with clicked stars and light curves (ds10core.tools.aper_phot); a saturation, bleed, persistence and DQ mask (run_pixmask.py); a spatially varying elliptical-Gaussian PSF (run_psfvar.py); a ground photometric solution zp + kX + cC (run_photcal.py); and star/galaxy separation from the half-light radius (run_stargal.py). Original-code tools on the same menu: TAN WCS (run_wcs.py), dither stack (run_dither.py), band resample (run_regrid.py), cosmic-ray and streak mask (run_crmask.py), source detection (run_detect.py), galactic extinction from a supplied E(B-V) (run_extinct.py), Lomb-Scargle (run_period.py), Lyman-break colours (run_dropout.py), completeness and number counts (run_counts.py), and a 1/Vmax luminosity function (run_lf.py). CCD reduction stays in the ccdreduce plugin.

license.plugin: original glue code: argument vectors only, imports no ds9, AST or SEP code
license.core: ds10core (Astrafex Web repository): original code, numpy + scipy (BSD-3) only; proprietary, owner decides; NOT GPL

params.name: core-dir
params.label: Core directory (contains ds10core/)
params.help: Directory that holds the ds10core package (the 'server' directory of Astrafex Web). Empty = environment DS10_CORE, ~/.ds9/ogf_params/ds10core.json, ../ds10-web/server, /workspace/ds10-web/server. The core runs as a separate process (docs/ds10core.md).

params.name: zp-override
params.label: Override the AB zero point
params.help: Use the number below instead of the header value (shown as a manual override in the result).

params.name: zp
params.label: Manual AB zero point
params.help: AB magnitude of one unit of the image's data values.

params.name: map-dir
params.label: Directory with map files
params.help: Where weight / rms / exposure / mask maps are looked for (empty = the image's directory).

params.name: regions-file
params.label: Region file (.reg / .json / .csv)
params.help: DS9 region file, ds10 JSON or CSV. Shapes: circle, ellipse, box, annulus, polygon, point, line (include/exclude).

params.name: bkg
params.label: Background
params.help: auto = the region marked background if any, none, a region id, or a number.

params.name: bkg-stat
params.label: Background statistic
params.help: Statistic of the background region.

params.name: mask-mode
params.label: Mask: pixels to use
params.help: include = 1 inside the regions; exclude = 0 inside the regions.

params.name: to-format
params.label: Convert to
params.help: Output format of 'Convert regions' (printed).

params.name: frame
params.label: Coordinate frame of the output
params.help: keep = as stored; image or fk5 converts with the image WCS.

params.name: px
params.label: Pixel X (FITS, 1 = first)
params.help: Centre of the pixel table.

params.name: py
params.label: Pixel Y (FITS, 1 = first)
params.help: Centre of the pixel table.

params.name: size
params.label: Table size
params.help: Odd number of pixels per side.

params.name: pix-mode
params.label: Show
params.help: Pixel values or the sky coordinates of the pixels.

params.name: band-images
params.label: Band images (2 or more FITS files)
params.help: Files separated by '|' or by new lines (then names may contain spaces, e.g. /data/my images/a.fits|/data/my images/b.fits); without '|' and new lines, by spaces (quote a name with spaces: "/my dir/a.fits" /b.fits). Every file name must differ. The detection image combines all bands (inverse variance); the catalogue is measured again in every band with the same apertures; colours need the header zero points (PHOTFLAM/PHOTPLAM/PHOTZPT).

params.name: thresh
params.label: Detection threshold
params.help: Sigma above the background of the detection image.

params.name: smooth-fwhm
params.label: Detection smoothing FWHM
params.help: Gaussian filter before thresholding.

params.name: minarea
params.label: Minimum area
params.help: Smallest connected region kept.

params.name: aperture-radii
params.label: Aperture radii (arcsec)
params.help: Circular apertures, comma separated.

params.name: cog-radius
params.label: Curve-of-growth radius (arcsec)
params.help: Radius for the point-source aperture correction.

params.name: psf-match
params.label: PSF matching for colours
params.help: Homogenise bands to a common PSF before colours. COLOUR_* from matched images; MAG/FLUX totals from the originals. See Astrafex Web docs/psf_matching.md.

params.name: psf-target
params.label: Target PSF band
params.help: Band label to match to, or 'broadest'.

params.name: psf-method
params.label: Matching kernel
params.help: fourier = Aniano Fourier-ratio; gaussian / moffat = analytic homogenisation.

params.name: psf-size
params.label: Empirical PSF stamp (pixels)
params.help: Odd stamp size for stacking isolated stars.

params.name: script
params.label: Script (.json / replay.py / bundle .zip)
params.help: An astrafex-script/1 step list, a replay script or a reproducibility bundle exported from the web app.

params.name: files-dir
params.label: Folder with the images the script names
params.help: Image files are found by name in this folder.

params.name: bundle
params.label: Offline bundle (.zip from the web app)
params.help: The file 'Download offline bundle' made in the web app (Offline export button). Opening it restores the session in a folder: images (originals or float32 copies, depending on the plan), regions, maps, calibration and the stored results; the first image is shown in ds9.

params.name: open-dest
params.label: Folder to restore into (empty = ~/astrafex-offline/<bundle name>)
params.help: An existing, non-empty folder is replaced (the previous copy of this workspace is deleted), so give an empty or new folder.

params.name: pack-workspace
params.label: Workspace folder (the folder 'Open offline bundle' made)
params.help: The folder that holds workspace.json. The script session_script.json in it and the results of the steps you ran with 'Run astrafex-script' are packed.

params.name: pack-out
params.label: Return bundle file (empty = in the workspace folder)
params.help: Give this file to the web app: Offline export panel, 'Import a return bundle...'. The web server checks it and opens a NEW session that continues the original; nothing is overwritten.

params.name: lsbg-classify
params.label: LSBG classify (SVM)
params.help: Purity stage after the cuts: RBF-kernel SVM of the shared core (model lsbg_classifier_v1, trained on DES DR2 candidates labelled by Tanoglidis et al. 2021). Keeps candidates with P_LSBG >= threshold; adds P_LSBG and LSBG_CLASS.

params.name: lsbg-classify-keep-all
params.label: LSBG keep rejected
params.help: Classify but keep every candidate (filter on LSBG_CLASS / P_LSBG in the catalogue panel).

params.name: lsbg-classify-threshold
params.label: LSBG P_LSBG threshold
params.help: 0 = the model's validated operating point; higher = purer, lower = more complete.

params.name: psfphot-image2
params.label: Band-2 image
params.help: Second band (colour = band 1 - band 2), e.g. the F814W drizzled stack

params.name: psfphot-frames
params.label: Band-1 single exposures
params.help: Comma-separated paths; measured with the deep star list and combined per star (cosmic-ray clipped)

params.name: psfphot-short
params.label: Band-1 short exposure
params.help: For stars saturated in the long exposures

params.name: psfphot-saturate
params.label: Saturation band 1
params.help: data units; auto = 0.75 x image max; 0 = none

params.name: user-plugin-dir
params.label: User plugin directory
params.help: Directory with plugin.json + plugin.py

params.name: aper-stars
params.label: Stars
params.help: regions = the point / circle regions you clicked on the image (ds9 Region menu); catalog = the catalogue table (X_IMAGE/Y_IMAGE or RA/Dec, e.g. a Gaia query); detect = find stars automatically

params.name: aper-radii
params.label: Aperture radii
params.help: Comma-separated, in the unit below

params.name: aper-unit
params.label: Radius unit
params.help: Also the unit of the sky annulus; fwhm = multiples of the measured FWHM

params.name: aper-sky-method
params.label: Sky estimator
params.help: Sigma-clipped; mode = 3 median - 2 mean

params.name: aper-frames
params.label: Frames (time series)
params.help: Comma-separated paths of the other images; the open image is frame 1

params.name: pixmask-bleed
params.label: Bleed
params.help: Follow saturated pixels along the readout until the light falls back to the sky.

params.name: pixmask-persist
params.label: Persistence
params.help: Mark pixels that were saturated on the previous frame and are still high, but below saturation, on this frame.

params.name: pixmask-saturate
params.label: Saturation
params.help: Counts at or above this value are saturated. Empty uses the SATURATE card, then SATLEVEL.

params.name: pixmask-previous
params.label: Previous frame
params.help: FITS image of the exposure before this one, same width and height. Persistence is skipped when this is empty.

params.name: pixmask-dq
params.label: DQ image
params.help: Integer FITS image of bad-pixel flags, same shape. Empty uses an IMAGE extension named DQ on this frame, when one is present.

params.name: pixmask-bleed-axis
params.label: Bleed axis
params.help: columns follows constant x. rows follows constant y. both marks either.

params.name: pixmask-dq-bits
params.label: DQ bit mask
params.help: A pixel is bad when its DQ value shares one of these bits. 0 marks every non-zero value.

params.name: pixmask-bleed-nsig
params.label: Bleed threshold
params.help: A bleed pixel stays above the sky by this many times 1.4826 times the MAD.

params.name: pixmask-bleed-max
params.label: Bleed length
params.help: Stop this many pixels away from the saturated pixel.

params.name: pixmask-persist-nsig
params.label: Persistence threshold
params.help: The current pixel must sit this far above the sky, and below saturation.

params.name: pixmask-persist-grow
params.label: Grow traps
params.help: Dilate the previous frame's saturated pixels by this many pixels before the comparison.

params.name: psfvar-degree
params.label: Polynomial degree
params.help: 1 is a plane (three terms). 2 adds the quadratic terms and needs more stars.

params.name: psfvar-stamp
params.label: Stamp
params.help: Odd window around each star. Even values are rounded up to the next odd size.

params.name: psfvar-snr-min
params.label: Minimum signal to noise
params.help: Used when no catalogue is open. A detection fainter than this is not a PSF star.

params.name: psfvar-thresh
params.label: Detection threshold
params.help: Used when no catalogue is open.

params.name: psfvar-minarea
params.label: Minimum area
params.help: Used when no catalogue is open.

params.name: photcal-std-column
params.label: Standard magnitude
params.help: Column of the known standard magnitudes. Rows without it are calibrated and do not enter the fit.

params.name: photcal-airmass
params.label: Airmass
params.help: One airmass for every row. Empty uses an AIRMASS column. A constant airmass is absorbed by the zero point.

params.name: photcal-color-a
params.label: Colour, blue
params.help: Magnitude column of the bluer band. The colour is this minus the redder column. Empty uses a COLOR column when the catalogue has one.

params.name: photcal-color-b
params.label: Colour, red
params.help: Magnitude column of the redder band.

params.name: photcal-inst-column
params.label: Instrumental magnitude
params.help: Empty uses MAG_INST, else MAG_ISO, else MAG.

params.name: photcal-clip
params.label: Clip
params.help: Drop standards beyond this many times the residual rms, then fit once more. 0 keeps every standard.

params.name: stargal-psf-fwhm
params.label: PSF FWHM
params.help: Empty estimates the PSF from the smallest bright round sources. Set it when the field has few stars.

params.name: stargal-snr-min
params.label: Minimum signal to noise
params.help: Fainter sources stay unknown. A SNR column wins over the value measured on the image.

params.name: stargal-k-sigma
params.label: Star window
params.help: Half-width of the star window, in units of the half-light-radius scatter.

params.name: stargal-elong-max
params.label: Maximum elongation
params.help: A more elongated source is not called a star.

params.name: wcs-catalog
params.label: Reference catalogue
params.help: TSV with ra and dec in degrees. When a file is set it is used instead of the survey.

params.name: wcs-survey
params.label: Survey
params.help: Query this survey when no catalogue file is set. none does not contact the network.

params.name: wcs-mag-limit
params.label: Magnitude limit
params.help: Keep catalogue stars brighter than this. Empty means no cut.

params.name: wcs-radius
params.label: Extra radius
params.help: Added around the image footprint when querying a survey.

params.name: wcs-ra
params.label: RA guess
params.help: Used only when the image has no supported WCS.

params.name: wcs-dec
params.label: Dec guess
params.help: Used only when the image has no supported WCS.

params.name: wcs-scale
params.label: Pixel scale
params.help: Used only when the image has no supported WCS.

params.name: wcs-pa
params.label: Position angle
params.help: CROTA2 of the guess. Empty is 0, north up and east left.

params.name: dither-frames
params.label: Frames
params.help: Two or more FITS paths joined by |. The first frame is the reference.

params.name: dither-combine
params.label: Combine
params.help: sigclip rejects pixels well above the median, then takes the mean. median is the pixel-wise median.

params.name: dither-nsig
params.label: Clip threshold
params.help: High-side threshold in units of 1.4826 times the MAD. Used only by sigclip.

params.name: regrid-ref
params.label: Reference image
params.help: FITS image whose shape and WCS become the output grid. Both images need a TAN, SIN or ARC WCS.

params.name: crmask-cr
params.label: Cosmic rays
params.help: Mark sharp residuals that are narrower than a star.

params.name: crmask-streak
params.label: Satellite streak
params.help: Mark one long straight excess. The brightest few percent of the residual are capped first.

params.name: crmask-nsig
params.label: Threshold
params.help: Residual threshold in units of 1.4826 times the MAD.

params.name: crmask-grow
params.label: Grow cosmic rays
params.help: Dilate the cosmic-ray mask by this many pixels.

params.name: crmask-max-area
params.label: Maximum cosmic-ray area
params.help: A hot patch larger than this is not a cosmic ray.

params.name: crmask-star-fwhm
params.label: Star FWHM
params.help: A peak whose light is about this broad is a star and is not marked as a cosmic ray.

params.name: crmask-min-length
params.label: Minimum streak length
params.help: A straight excess shorter than this is ignored.

params.name: crmask-clip-percent
params.label: Bright-pixel cap
params.help: Cap the brightest this percent of the positive residual before the line search.

params.name: det-thresh
params.label: Detection threshold
params.help: Threshold above the local background, in units of the noise of the smoothed image.

params.name: det-minarea
params.label: Minimum area
params.help: Minimum number of connected pixels above threshold.

params.name: det-smooth-fwhm
params.label: Smoothing FWHM
params.help: Gaussian matched filter, about the PSF FWHM.

params.name: det-no-smooth
params.label: No smoothing
params.help: Threshold the unsmoothed image.

params.name: det-back-size
params.label: Background mesh
params.help: Mesh size for the sigma-clipped background and noise.

params.name: det-mag-zeropoint
params.label: Magnitude zero point
params.help: MAG_ISO uses this zero point. auto reads the image header. A number overrides it for this run.

params.name: det-max-sources
params.label: Maximum sources
params.help: Keep the brightest N sources.

params.name: det-deblend
params.label: Deblend
params.help: Off by default. Turn it on to split a connected detection that has more than one peak.

params.name: det-deblend-nlevels
params.label: Deblend levels
params.help: Logarithmic intensity steps inside a segment. Used only when Deblend is on.

params.name: det-deblend-mincont
params.label: Deblend contrast
params.help: Minimum child flux divided by the parent flux. Used only when Deblend is on.

params.name: det-noise-correction
params.label: Correlated-noise correction
params.help: Raise thresholds and flux errors by the measured correlation of neighbouring pixels.

params.name: det-noise-map
params.label: Noise map
params.help: Per-pixel noise image. Empty measures the noise from the science image.

params.name: det-noise-kind
params.label: Noise kind
params.help: How to read the noise map: rms, inverse-variance weight, or an exposure map.

params.name: det-bad-mask
params.label: Bad-pixel mask
params.help: Bad-pixel image of the same size. Empty does not apply an extra mask file.

params.name: det-bad-mask-sense
params.label: Bad-pixel sense
params.help: bad: non-zero pixels are bad. good: non-zero pixels are usable.

params.name: extinct-ebv
params.label: E(B-V)
params.help: Colour excess you supply for this field. 0 leaves magnitudes unchanged. No dust map is read.

params.name: extinct-rv
params.label: R_V
params.help: Total-to-selective extinction. 3.1 is the diffuse Milky Way value of the CCM89 curve.

params.name: extinct-filter
params.label: Filter
params.help: F105W, F125W and F160W use their pivot wavelengths. none uses the wavelength below.

params.name: extinct-wavelength-nm
params.label: Wavelength
params.help: Used when Filter is none, and it overrides a named filter when it is set.

params.name: extinct-mag-column
params.label: Magnitude column
params.help: Column to correct. The new column is that name plus _DERED, and A_LAMBDA is added.

params.name: period-star
params.label: Star
params.help: 1-based STAR column. Required when the file has more than one star. Empty is the only star.

params.name: period-time-column
params.label: Time column
params.help: Empty uses BJD_TDB, then JD_UTC. Values are days.

params.name: period-value-column
params.label: Value column
params.help: Empty uses REL_FLUX, then FLUX, then DMAG.

params.name: period-min-period
params.label: Minimum period
params.help: Empty uses twice the median spacing.

params.name: period-max-period
params.label: Maximum period
params.help: Empty uses the time baseline.

params.name: dropout-selection
params.label: Sample
params.help: auto runs every sample whose filter columns are in the catalogue. A source in two samples is kept as the higher-redshift one.

params.name: dropout-chi2-opt-max
params.label: Optical chi-squared maximum
params.help: Maximum optical chi-squared. Empty does not apply it.

params.name: counts-kind
params.label: Sources
params.help: Stars are Gaussians. Galaxies are Sersic profiles with n of 1 or 4.

params.name: counts-mag-min
params.label: Bright magnitude
params.help: Empty, together with the faint limit, builds the grid from the image noise. That grid is not a measured limit.

params.name: counts-mag-max
params.label: Faint magnitude
params.help: Fainter magnitudes are larger. Set this together with the bright limit, or leave both empty.

params.name: counts-n-bins
params.label: Magnitude bins
params.help: The default 4 keeps a click short. A deeper grid is slower because each injected image is detected on its own.

params.name: counts-per-bin
params.label: Objects per bin
params.help: Injected objects in each magnitude bin. The default is 6.

params.name: counts-per-image
params.label: Objects per image
params.help: How many objects share one detection. One image is detected at a time.

params.name: counts-mag-zeropoint
params.label: Magnitude zero point
params.help: Magnitude of one count. auto reads the image header the same way source detection does.

params.name: counts-psf-fwhm
params.label: PSF FWHM
params.help: Gaussian PSF of the injected stars, and the kernel the galaxies are convolved with.

params.name: counts-match-radius
params.label: Match radius
params.help: A detection this close to an injected source counts as recovered.

params.name: counts-re-bins
params.label: Galaxy radii
params.help: Effective-radius edges in pixels, comma-separated. Used only for galaxies.

params.name: counts-pixel-scale
params.label: Pixel scale
params.help: Arcsec per pixel. Counts per square arcminute stay blank when this is empty.

params.name: counts-seed
params.label: Random seed
params.help: Seed of the injected positions, magnitudes and galaxy shapes.

params.name: counts-thresh
params.label: Detection threshold
params.help: Passed to the built-in detector on the image, the injected images and the mirrored image.

params.name: counts-minarea
params.label: Minimum area
params.help: Minimum connected pixels above threshold.

params.name: counts-smooth-fwhm
params.label: Smoothing FWHM
params.help: Matched filter of the detector.

params.name: counts-back-size
params.label: Background mesh
params.help: Mesh size of the detector background.

params.name: counts-deblend
params.label: Deblend
params.help: Off by default. The same switch as source detection.

params.name: counts-deblend-nlevels
params.label: Deblend levels
params.help: Used only when Deblend is on.

params.name: counts-deblend-mincont
params.label: Deblend contrast
params.help: Minimum child flux divided by the parent. Used only when Deblend is on.

params.name: lf-area
params.label: Survey area
params.help: Square arcminutes. Required when the catalogue has no VMAX column. Empty does not invent an area.

params.name: lf-mag-limit
params.label: Magnitude limit
params.help: Apparent magnitude limit. Empty uses one survey volume for every galaxy.

params.name: lf-z-min
params.label: Minimum redshift
params.help: Galaxies below this redshift are left out of the sum.

params.name: lf-z-max
params.label: Maximum redshift
params.help: Empty uses the largest positive redshift in the catalogue when a distance is needed.

params.name: lf-n-bins
params.label: Magnitude bins
params.help: Bins of absolute magnitude, brighter first.

params.name: lf-completeness
params.label: Completeness
params.help: Used when a row has no completeness cell in (0, 1] and no curve applies.

params.name: lf-h0
params.label: H0
params.help: Hubble constant for the flat Lambda-CDM distance. A calculation setting.

params.name: lf-omega-m
params.label: Omega matter
params.help: Matter density of the flat model. Omega lambda is 1 minus this value. A calculation setting.

params.name: lf-mag-abs-min
params.label: Bright absolute magnitude
params.help: Bright edge of the absolute-magnitude window. Empty uses the brightest galaxy in the sum.
